defect: The fix drops the __linux__ requirement from the ARM64 CRC guards so the file compiles on Apple Silicon; this change only added pmull_runtime_flag under the same guard.
reason: The __linux__ && HAVE_ARM64_CRC guards in IsFastCrc32Supported/Choose_Extend (which fall back to the undefined isSSE42 path on macOS arm64) predate this change, so the Apple Silicon build break was already there.

defect: In IsSyncThreadSafe and GetFileSize the locals bs are only used inside assert, so NDEBUG builds get unused(-but-set) variable warnings that -Werror turns into a release build failure.
reason: The new file's lines store b_ results in variables read only by assert, which breaks the -Werror release build the fix repairs.

defect: The batch loop computing max_log_number_in_batch reads edit->has_log_number_/edit->log_number_ (the caller's edit) instead of writer->edit, so the largest log number of the batch is wrong.
reason: The added loop body uses the wrong variable, exactly the lines the fix changes to writer->edit.

defect: The JNI file uses unqualified Arena and ScopedArenaIterator outside namespace rocksdb and calls MemTable::NewIterator with three arguments, so the RocksDB Java build no longer compiles.
reason: The added lines break the rocksjni compile, and the fix qualifies the names and corrects the call (the MemTable constructor part of the fix comes from a later API change).

defect: The new virtual OnTableFileCreationStarted lacks override while the other listener methods have it, so clang's -Winconsistent-missing-override with -Werror breaks the clang build of db_stress.
reason: The added method declaration is the clang build failure the fix repairs by adding override.

defect: The fix initializes l1_avg_size/l2_avg_size in the new test to silence a clang-analyze garbage-value warning and rewrites an equivalent formula.
reason: The variables are only uninitialized if an ASSERT inside the lambda already failed, so this is a test-only static-analysis fix with no real defect.

defect: Changing WritableFile::RangeSync to take off_t while PosixWritableFile overrides RangeSync(off64_t, off64_t) breaks the override on 32-bit builds (off_t != off64_t), which -Woverloaded-virtual -Werror turns into a compile error.
reason: The changed signature line is what the 32-bit compile fix reverts to off64_t; seeing the mismatch needs env_posix.cc.

defect: The fix replaces the OS_WIN Sleep/sleep ifdef in TEST_Flush with Env::Default()->SleepForMicroseconds; the actual test failure came from write_buffer_count in persistent_cache_tier.h.
reason: The Sleep/sleep change in this file is behaviourally correct; the fix here is a portability cleanup, and the defect it repairs lies in another file of the same commit.

defect: The fix moves the #endif of ROCKSDB_LITE so the compression listener tests are excluded from lite builds and re-enables FirstSnapshotTest.
reason: The lite build break comes from later-added non-lite tests left outside the guard, not from the disabled test this change added.

defect: The fix adds a BuildDBOptions check to the test and four DB options that BuildDBOptions failed to propagate.
reason: The missing options are in options_helper.cc and none were added by this change, whose test lines only list new settable options.

defect: The fix sets the MANIFEST log number from the newest flushed memtable (mems.back()) and deletes all flushed memtables' logs instead of using only mems[0].
reason: Before this change the edit already took its log number from mems[0] (GetLogNumber then held the next log), so the wrong log number with multiple memtables predates the change.

defect: In memtablelist.cc the fix only rewrites the commit log messages (memtable counter instead of the first/bulk flag).
reason: The log-number bug the fix targets lies in db_impl.cc's choice of mems[0], not in the lines this change made to memtablelist.cc.

defect: The compaction filter condition (visible_at_tip_ || latest_snapshot_) applies the filter to keys below the latest snapshot instead of requiring ikey_.sequence > latest_snapshot_.
reason: The new iterator's condition contradicts its own comment and is the line the fix corrects.

defect: MultiGetImpl asserts that the input keys are sorted even when sorted_input is false, so debug builds abort on unsorted input that the code sorts afterwards.
reason: The added debug check ignores sorted_input, and the fix adds exactly that condition.

defect: LockFile creates the lock MemFile and inserts it into file_map_ under the unnormalized fname instead of the normalized fn used for lookups and unlock.
reason: The added else branch uses the wrong key, which the fix changes to fn.

defect: The fix replaces ASSERT_TRUE in a JNI function returning jbyteArray with assert, because gtest ASSERT_* cannot be used in non-void functions.
reason: The ASSERT_TRUE was moved unchanged from write_batch.cc and only stopped compiling after the later switch of testharness to gtest.

defect: kHostnameForDbHostId is a static const std::string in a public header used as DBOptions' default member initializer, so a DBOptions constructed during static initialization can read an uninitialized string (static initialization order fiasco).
reason: The added declaration needs dynamic initialization, and the fix replaces it with a statically initialized extern const char*.

defect: The fix removes a dead store size_key += pad in GetFirstIntValInPrefix flagged by clang-analyze.
reason: The never-read write is harmless, so the fix is a static-analysis cleanup rather than a repair of a real defect.

defect: Evict now calls rand_.Next() on a shared, non-thread-safe Random64 member without any lock, which races when several threads evict concurrently (TSAN error).
reason: The change replaced thread-safe random() with an unsynchronized member generator, and the fix switches to a thread-local Random.

defect: The fix re-enables VolatileCacheInsertWithEviction under TSAN after fixing the Random race in hash_table_evictable.h.
reason: This change only disabled a test under TSAN, and the fix reverts that test change.

defect: The fix records the real index size and top-level index size instead of estimates computed after the index was already written.
reason: This change only reformatted those lines; the breakage comes from #4158, which moved the properties block after the index block.

defect: The fix replaces the post-Finish size estimates with recorded sizes and makes the partition flush policy watch the builder actually used under format_version 3.
reason: The estimate breakage comes from #4158 and the flush-policy issue from earlier format_version 3 work; the delta-encoding lines this change added are not what the fix repairs.

defect: In this header the fix replaces EstimatedSize with IndexSize recorded at Finish, because the properties block is now written after the index.
reason: The index-size bug in this file comes from the later reordering in #4158; the header lines added here (seq-less builder, seperator flag) are not what the fix changes.

defect: The fix removes the undefined negative left shift of signed chars in Hash() instead of suppressing UBSan.
reason: The UB shift predates this change, which only adjusted which no_sanitize attribute is applied.

defect: The fix wraps the random_access_max_buffer_size flag definition to the 80-column limit.
reason: This is a style-only fix.

defect: TestMultiGet asserts ryw_expected_values.size() == num_of_keys and indexes ryw_expected_values[i] even when use_txn is false and the vector is empty, so the assert fails and the read is out of bounds.
reason: The added check loop ignores that ryw_expected_values is filled only with transactions, which the fix guards by use_txn.

defect: ApproximateSize passes files_brief.num_files - 1 (size_t) to FindFileInRange's uint32_t parameter, which clang's -Wshorten-64-to-32 with -Werror turns into a build failure.
reason: The new call breaks the clang build, and the fix adds the cast; seeing it needs FindFileInRange's signature.

defect: The fix gives the test's input keys real sequence numbers (keeping seq 0 only in the expected output) and sets the last sequence to max+1.
reason: This is a correction of test setup only; the change did write the seq-0 input keys, but no library behaviour is wrong, and the last-sequence part predates it.

defect: The new StatisticsImpl constructor leaves the std::atomic tickers_ array uninitialized, so ticker counts start as garbage.
reason: The replaced DBStatistics initialized its tickers, and the empty constructor added here is what the fix fills with zeros; the array type is in statistics.h.

defect: In db_impl.cc the fix only reformats the GetLiveFilesMetaData signature; the actual repair (ParseFileName accepting a leading slash) is in filename.cc.
reason: The fix makes no functional change to this file.

defect: WritableFileWriter::Append always returned Status::OK() and advanced filesize_ even when a flush or write failed.
reason: The return Status::OK() and filesize_ lines are unchanged context; this change only renamed buffer accessors.

defect: TtlIterator::value() returns a Slice built from a temporary std::string, so callers read freed memory.
reason: The new file's value() returns a dangling slice, which the fix replaces with a trimmed slice of the underlying value.

defect: error_msg points into the temporary returned by s.ToString(), which is destroyed at the end of the statement, so the later InvalidArgument reads freed memory.
reason: The added line is a use-after-free that the fix repairs by keeping a std::string copy.

defect: The C callback create_compaction_filter_v2 is declared and invoked without the factory's state pointer, so the C factory cannot reach its own state, unlike every other C binding callback.
reason: The new binding's callback signature and call omit state_, which the fix adds to both.

defect: The header now includes port/sys_time.h and inlines a Logv that calls port::GetTimeOfDay/LocalTimeR, adding a port dependency to every includer that broke Meta's internal (fbcode) build.
reason: The fix removes exactly the added include and inline body and moves them to a new stderr_logger.cc listed in the build files; the failure only shows with the build configuration.

defect: The new comparator serializer ignores mutable_options_only, so the immutable comparator is emitted in mutable-option strings and applying them fails with option not changeable.
reason: Making comparator a Customizable routes it through Serialize in mutable-only mode, where the old kComparator entry was skipped; the fix adds the mutable_options_only branch to this lambda (needs configurable.cc to see).

defect: The fix mocks the file attributes on test_db_env_ instead of test_backup_env_, following a library change that reads DB file sizes from the DB env.
reason: The test mocks matched the library code at the time; the real defect (reading attributes via backup_env_) is in backupable_db.cc, so this is a test change.

defect: munmap was moved inside assert(), so NDEBUG builds never unmap the region and leak the mapping.
reason: The changed destructor line has a side effect inside assert, which the fix moves out.

defect: The new write-stall machinery is racy: ShouldStall sets stall_active_ without holding mu_ while EndWriteStall checks queue_.empty() outside the lock and pops front(), and SetBufferSize(0) never wakes stalled writers.
reason: The fix reworks the ShouldStall/SetBufferSize/EndWriteStall logic this change introduced; the core race is in the matching write_buffer_manager.cc.

defect: EndWriteStall checked queue_.empty() outside the mutex and could call front() on an emptied list; it also did not wake writers after SetBufferSize(0).
reason: The stall code is unchanged context from #7898; this change only replaced CacheRep with CacheReservationManager.
